Neither pairs in DRC today (mate against stepperonline-17hs19-2004s1: not_configured).

towerpro-sg90 exposes rc_servo_3wire as pwm/device with capability rc_pwm_in; the shield's servo headers are modelled as pwm/host with an rc_pwm_out signal leaf. No pairing in DRC (mate against towerpro-sg90: not_configured). A servo-port builder would settle it.

No interface type for an Arduino UNO R3 shield header stack (the ProtoPart arduino_uno_shield protocol). Header pins are leaves bound to the header bodies in the CAD; the mechanical mate is the partial bolt pattern.
